Fear of Change Friday Meeting

After four incredible years, The JADFA House made the difficult decision to conclude the Fear of Change Friday Meeting at the end of 2025.

What Are the Rules for Attending Meetings at JADFA House?

  • You must have a genuine desire to stop drinking alcohol or using drugs.
  • You must be respectful of others at all times.
  • You are not required to speak during a meeting, but you must be polite and attentive to anyone who chooses to speak.
  • We are a kid-friendly space. All children must be accompanied by an adult.
  • Meetings are come-as-you-are – we welcome individuals with both new and long term recovery.
  • Please arrive a few minutes before the meeting time to get settled.
  • Attendance is free – as are snacks, water and hot coffee.
  • If you have questions regarding meetings, please email them to [email protected].
